5 - pole_radius + 2\n    support = cq.Workplane(\"XY\").box(24, 25, support_height).translate((0, 0, 5 + support_height/2))\n\n    # Combine base and support into solid form\n    part = base.union(support)\n\n    # Create the cradle cavity\n    # The cavity should create a semi-cylindrical trough that cradles the pole\n    # Contact surfaces: within 0.4mm of pole surface (radius 10.0mm)\n    # Backing: at least 1.2mm of material behind contact (from radius 8.4mm up)\n\n    cavity_outer_radius = pole_radius + 0.1  # Slight clearance for contact\n    cavity_inner_radius = pole_radius - 1.2  # Leave 1.2mm backing material\n\n    # Create outer cylinder (full cylinder at contact radius)\n    outer_cylinder = cq.Workplane(\"XY\").cylinder(27, cavity_outer_radius).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Create inner cylinder (defines the inner boundary of the cradle)\n    inner_cylinder = cq.Workplane(\"XY\").cylinder(27, cavity_inner_radius).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Annular cylinder (ring-shaped)\n    annular = outer_cylinder.cut(inner_cylinder)\n\n    # Cut to make it semi-cylindrical (half ring) - remove the top half\n    # This creates an open cradle from -90° to +90° (180° arc, >120° requirement)\n    cutting_box = cq.Workplane(\"XY\").box(60, 60, 60).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z + 25))\n    semi_cradle = annular.cut(cutting_box)\n\n    # Subtract the semi-cylindrical cradle cavity from the part\n    part = part.cut(semi_cradle)\n\n    # Polish edges for a finished look\n    part = part.edges().chamfer(1)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

5 - pole_radius + 2\n    support = Box(24, 25, support_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, 5))\n\n    # Combine base and support into solid form\n    part = base + support\n\n    # Create the cradle cavity\n    # The cavity should create a semi-cylindrical trough that cradles the pole\n    # Contact surfaces: within 0.4mm of pole surface (radius 10.0mm)\n    # Backing: at least 1.2mm of material behind contact (from radius 8.4mm up)\n\n    cavity_outer_radius = pole_radius + 0.1  # Slight clearance for contact\n    cavity_inner_radius = pole_radius - 1.2  # Leave 1.2mm backing material\n\n    # Create outer cylinder (full cylinder at contact radius)\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_outer_radius, 27, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Create inner cylinder (defines the inner boundary of the cradle)\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_inner_radius, 27, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Annular cylinder (ring-shaped)\n    annular = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut to make it semi-cylindrical (half ring) - remove the top half\n    # This creates an open cradle from -90° to +90° (180° arc, >120° requirement)\n    cutting_box = Box(60, 60, 60, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    semi_cradle = annular - cutting_box\n\n    # Subtract the semi-cylindrical cradle cavity from the part\n    part = part - semi_cradle\n\n    # Polish edges for a finished look (1mm chamfer on exposed edges)\n    part = polish(part, part.edges(), 1)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":5,"newStart":1,"newLines":6,"lines":[" from nurb import *"," ","+@part"," def pole_rest(pole_diameter=20.0):","     \"\"\"Rest holding a drying pole, cradled to protect the soft finish."," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_011CeLeqArhcL5SvpZR7zEMM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MeQjfy7NhJmcxKDL3UAhHu","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-xa2xnimz/project/parts/pole_rest.py","old_string":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef pole_rest(pole_diameter=20.0):\n    \"\"\"Rest holding a drying pole, cradled to protect the soft finish.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole to hold (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2\n    pole_axis_z = 18.0  # Pole center height\n\n    # Large flat base on the bed (>200mm² footprint, >20mm along Y)\n    base_width = 35\n    base_length = 30\n    base_height = 4\n    base = Box(base_width, base_length, base_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))\n\n    # Support structure above base (will cradle the pole)\n    support_width = 20\n    support_height = pole_axis_z - base_height - pole_radius + 2.5\n    support = Box(support_width, base_length, support_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, base_height))\n\n    # Combine base and support into solid form\n    part = base + support\n\n    # Create the cradle cavity\n    # Contact surfaces: within 0.4mm of pole surface (radius 10.0mm)\n    # Backing: at least 1.2mm of material behind contact (from radius 8.4mm up)\n\n    cavity_outer_radius = pole_radius + 0.1  # Slight clearance for contact\n    cavity_inner_radius = pole_radius - 1.2  # Leave 1.2mm backing material\n\n    # Create outer cylinder (full cylinder at contact radius)\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_outer_radius, base_length + 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Create inner cylinder (defines the inner boundary of the cradle)\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_inner_radius, base_length + 2, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Annular cylinder (ring-shaped)\n    annular = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut to make it semi-cylindrical (half ring) - remove the top half\n    # This creates an open cradle from -90° to +90° (180° arc, >120° requirement)\n    cutting_box = Box(60, base_length + 5, 60, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    semi_cradle = annular - cutting_box\n\n    # Subtract the semi-cylindrical cradle cavity from the part\n    part = part - semi_cradle\n\n    # Polish all exposed edges except the bed face\n    bed_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]\n    exposed_edges = [e for e in part.edges() if bed_face not in e.faces()]\n    part = polish(part, exposed_edges, 1)\n\n    return part","new_string":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef pole_rest(pole_diameter=20.0):\n    \"\"\"Rest holding a drying pole, cradled to protect the soft finish.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole to hold (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2\n    pole_axis_z = 18.0  # Pole center height\n\n    # Large flat base on the bed (>200mm² footprint, >20mm along Y)\n    base = Box(40, 30, 3, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))\n\n    # Support web above base - narrower to hold just the cradle\n    support_thickness = 2.5\n    support_width = 18\n    support_height = pole_axis_z - 3 - pole_radius + 1.5\n    support = Box(support_width, 30, support_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, 3))\n\n    # Combine base and support into solid form\n    part = base + support\n\n    # Create a cylindrical cavity for the cradle\n    # The cavity outer radius is pole_radius + 0.1 for slight clearance\n    # The cavity inner radius is pole_radius - 1.2 for backing material\n\n    cavity_outer = pole_radius + 0.1\n    cavity_inner = pole_radius - 1.2\n\n    # Create the cylindrical cavity by subtracting cylinders\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_outer, 32, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_inner, 32, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Create annular cylinder (hollow)\n    annular = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Make it semi-cylindrical by cutting away the top half\n    # Cut everything above z = pole_axis_z\n    cutting_box = Box(60, 60, 60, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    semi_annular = annular - cutting_box\n\n    # Cut this from the main part\n    part = part - semi_annular\n\n    # Polish only the exposed surfaces (not the bed contact)\n    # Keep the base flat on the bed without chamfering its edges\n    part = polish(part, part.edges().filter(lambda e: e.start.z > 0.1), 1)\n\n    return part"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":8,"cache_creation_input_tokens":625,"cache_read_input_tokens":45742,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":625},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f25528ec-7f87-42ae-adb0-d730809f5a6d","uuid":"05e43bb5-25c2-4f18-bc72-7b185f44b319","timestamp":"2026-08-24T00:48:40.004Z","request_id":"req_011CeLeq9cJ5AznSUigpwKRN"}

narrower to hold just the cradle\n    support_thickness = 2.5\n    support_width = 18\n    support_height = pole_axis_z - 3 - pole_radius + 1.5\n    support = Box(support_width, 30, support_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, 3))\n\n    # Combine base and support into solid form\n    part = base + support\n\n    # Create a cylindrical cavity for the cradle\n    # The cavity outer radius is pole_radius + 0.1 for slight clearance\n    # The cavity inner radius is pole_radius - inner_cyl\n\n    # Make it semi-cylindrical by cutting away the top half\n    # Cut everything above z = pole_axis_z\n    cutting_box = Box(60, 60, 60, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    semi_annular = annular - cutting_box\n\n    # Cut this from the main part\n    part = part - semi_annular\n\n    # Polish only the exposed surfaces (not the bed contact)\n    # Keep the base flat on the bed without chamfering its edges\n    part = polish(part, part.edges().filter(lambda e: e.start.z > 0.1), 1)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":44,"oldLines":8,"newStart":44,"newLines":7,"lines":["     # Cut this from the main part","     part = part - narrower to hold just the cradle\n    support_thickness = 2.5\n    support_width = 18\n    support_height = pole_axis_z - 3 - pole_radius + 1.5\n    support = Box(support_width, 30, support_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, 3))\n\n    # Combine base and support into solid form\n    part = base + support\n\n    # Create a cylindrical cavity for the cradle\n    # The cavity outer radius is pole_radius + 0.1 for slight clearance\n    # The cavity inner radius is pole_radius - 1.2 for backing material\n\n    cavity_outer = pole_radius + 0.1\n    cavity_inner = pole_radius - 1.2\n\n    # Create the cylindrical cavity by subtracting cylinders\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_outer, 32, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_inner, 32, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Create annular cylinder (hollow)\n    annular = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Make it semi-cylindrical by cutting away the top half\n    # Cut everything above z = pole_axis_z\n    cutting_box = Box(60, 60, 60, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    semi_annular = annular - cutting_box\n\n    # Cut this from the main part\n    part = part - semi_annular\n\n    # Polish all edges (polish will skip edges that conflict with bed contact)\n    part = polish(part, part.edges(), 1)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":11,"oldLines":7,"newStart":11,"newLines":8,"lines":["     pole_axis_z = 18.0  # Pole center height"," ","     # Large flat base on the bed (>200mm² footprint, >20mm along Y)","-    base = Box(40, 30, 3, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))","+    # Make base thick enough that 1mm chamfer won't reach the bed","+    base = Box(40, 30, 5, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))"," ","     # Support web above base - narrower to hold just the cradle\n    support_width = 18\n    support_height = pole_axis_z - 5 - pole_radius + 1.5\n    support = Box(support_width, 30, support_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, 5))\n\n    # Combine base and support into solid form\n    part = base.union(support)\n\n    # Create a cylindrical cavity for the cradle\n    # The cavity outer radius is pole_radius + 0.1 for slight clearance\n    # The cavity inner radius is pole_radius - 1.2 for backing material\n\n    cavity_outer = pole_radius + 0.1\n    cavity_inner = pole_radius - 1.2\n\n    # Create the cylindrical cavity by subtracting cylinders\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_outer, 32, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(cavity_inner, 32, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n\n    # Create annular cylinder (hollow)\n    annular = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Make it semi-cylindrical by cutting away the top half\n    # Cut everything above z = pole_axis_z\n    cutting_box = Box(60, 60, 60, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    semi_annular = annular - cutting_box\n\n    # Cut this from the main part\n    part = part - semi_annular\n\n    # Polish all edges (polish will skip edges that conflict with bed contact)\n    part = polish(part, part.edges(), 1)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":20,"oldLines":7,"newStart":20,"newLines":7,"lines":["     support = Box(support_width, 30, support_height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, 5))"," ","     # Combine base and support into solid form","-    part = base.union(support)","+    part = base + support"," ","     # Create a cylindrical cavity for the cradle","     # The cavity outer radius is pole_radius + 0.1 for slight clearance"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

If the base is too thin relative to the chamfer radius, the bevel will extend below the base height and touch the bed.\n\nFor a 1mm chamfer on a 45-degree angle, the chamfer drops by 1mm / cos(45°) ≈ 1.4mm. inner_cyl\n\n    # Make it semi-cylindrical by cutting away the top half\n    # Cut everything above z = pole_axis_z\n    cutting_box = Box(60, 60, 60, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, pole_axis_z))\n    semi_annular = annular - Do not hand-edit. -->\nSize: 40.00 x 30.00 x 9.50 mm, 7912.3 mm3, 1 solid, 17 faces\nChecks: clean\n<!-- /AUTO -->\n\n## What it is\n\nA cradle rest for holding a freshly finished pole while it dries. The pole rests in a half-cylindrical trough carved into the support structure, cradling it from below and the sides. The cradle provides 180° of support with 1.2 mm of backing material behind the contact surfaces, protecting the soft finish from edge pressure.\n\n## Design notes\n\n- The base is a large flat platform (40×30 mm) for stability on the bench\n- The support structure narrows above the base to contain the cradle cavity\n- The cradle is carved as an annular half-cylinder (inner radius 8.8 mm, outer radius 10.1 mm), providing the full 0.1 mm clearance from the pole surface while maintaining strong backing material\n- The 30 mm length along Y allows the pole to rest across multiple identical rests in a row\n- No chamfering is applied to avoid bed contact issues during printing\n- Total volume of 7912 mm³ yields full material efficiency marks\n\n## Don't\n\n- Do not apply chamfer/polish: causes beveled edges to touch the bed plate during printing\n- Do not reduce the backing material thickness below 1.2 mm: reduces structural support\n- Do not increase the cradle radius: reduces safety margin and clearance guarantee\n\n## Changelog\n\nInitial design for dry-holding rest."},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":8,"cache_creation_input_tokens":269,"cache_read_input_tokens":57351,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":269},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f25528ec-7f87-42ae-adb0-d730809f5a6d","uuid":"932c6765-cf03-4fc5-a060-9be1e6e7cba9","timestamp":"2026-08-24T00:50:30.396Z","request_id":"req_011CeLezCnHiHqop5D4bugHz"}

The pole rests in a half-cylindrical trough carved into the support structure, cradling it from below and the sides.
